name: WPA Continuous Institutional Learning Loop
name_mk: Континуиран циклус на институционално учење на WPA
purpose: Connect WPA research, global institutional evidence, Protocolometry, governed AI assistance, human authority, publication and institutional learning into one evidence-based feedback cycle.
public_principle: Institutional strength is not the sum of its components; it is the quality of the governed connections between them.
public_principle_mk: Институционалната сила не е збир од нејзините компоненти; таа е квалитетот на управуваните врски меѓу нив.

derived_principles.name: AI as Governed Acceleration Layer
derived_principles.name_mk: ВИ како управуван слој за забрзување
derived_principles.rule: AI may accelerate discovery, comparison, modelling, synthesis and iteration; it does not inherit institutional mandate, legitimacy or final responsibility.

derived_principles.name: WPA Knowledge & Protocol Foraging
derived_principles.name_mk: WPA систематско откривање знаење и протоколарни практики
derived_principles.rule: Use public or authorised sources to discover emerging standards, research, institutional practice, protocol cases and technology signals; verify provenance before institutional use.

derived_principles.name: Institutional DNA Reuse Principle
derived_principles.name_mk: Принцип на повторна употреба на институционалната ДНК
derived_principles.rule: Verified institutional practices extracted from Evidence Dossiers may inform all eligible WPA Institute domains through source-traceable Practice Atoms, while preserving context, attribution, uncertainty and Human Gate controls.
boundaries: No consequential reuse without the applicable Human Gate

derived_principles.name: Capability-Resilience Pairing Principle
derived_principles.name_mk: Принцип на спарување на способноста и отпорноста
derived_principles.rule: Every new institutional capability must be evaluated together with the dependency, vulnerability, misuse path and authority risk it creates.
questions: What can fail or be misused?
Who can pause, override or revoke?
What evidence is required before release?

derived_principles.name: Outcome-Based Protocolometry
derived_principles.rule: Measure institutional performance by evidence-backed outcomes and correction capacity, not by the number of units, documents, agents or organisational labels.

derived_principles.name: Governed Connection Quality Principle
derived_principles.name_mk: Принцип на квалитет на управуваните врски
derived_principles.rule: WPA systems should be assessed not only individually but by the reliability, evidence flow, handoff quality and human-governance integrity of the connections between them.

non_claims: Not a military or intelligence model
Not permission for agents to bypass Human Gate
Not permission to copy proprietary curricula or protected expression
